note: Public-dev / private-scored split (4D.2). Disposition defaults to public_dev; list ids under private_scored to hold them out of the published release. Per-run nonces resist flag memorization for the public set; the private set resists STRUCTURE memorization and is rotated. The current suite is all public-dev (a private-scored set is authored later, never published with its structure).

rotation.policy: retire a private task once its cumulative model exposure risks contamination; replace it with a structurally-novel task in the same ATT&CK cell
rotation.exposure_log: every model x private-task run is logged (see references/threat-model.md, private-task controls)
